This is a founding/early-stage software engineer role (senior level, remote) at Continuum Resource Network, placing engineers with venture-backed startups to build AI-native products and production systems end-to-end alongside founders. The work spans backend services, APIs, data infrastructure, frontend surfaces, and cloud systems, plus LLM- and agent-based features with tool integrations and retrieval. The core stack is Python, TypeScript/JavaScript with React, Go, Java, or Rust, on cloud and distributed systems.
